name: Sylhet
summary: Green hills, tea gardens, rivers and shrines in the north-east. Sylhet is the base for Ratargul swamp forest, Jaflong, Bichanakandi, Lalakhal and the tea estates.
season_note: October to March is dry and clear. June to September has heavy rain; Ratargul is best in the rainy season when the swamp fills, but roads can flood.
avoid_note: Very heavy rain can close roads to Jaflong and Bichanakandi. Check the weather before the day trip.

reach.how: Parabat Express, Jayantika Express, Upaban Express and others from Kamalapur to Sylhet (check e-ticket for times)
reach.note: Most comfortable and reliable. Book early.

reach.how: AC coaches from Dhaka (Sayedabad, Kamalapur) - Hanif, Ena, Shyamoli
reach.note: Road traffic near Dhaka can add hours.

reach.how: Dhaka to Osmani International Airport (Biman, US-Bangla, Novoair)
reach.note: Quick and good for a 2-day trip.

local.note: Best for Jaflong, Ratargul and Bichanakandi.

attractions.name: Hazrat Shah Jalal (R.) Dargah
attractions.what: A famous 14th-century Sufi shrine with a pond of old catfish. Pilgrims visit day and night.
attractions.tip: Dress modestly. Remove shoes. Evenings are peaceful.

attractions.name: Ratargul Swamp Forest
attractions.what: Take a boat through submerged trees in Bangladesh's only freshwater swamp forest. Calm, green and very photogenic.
attractions.tip: Best in the rainy season (June-October). Life jackets are available; use them. Boat rental is per boat.

attractions.name: Jaflong
attractions.what: Rocks and river on the Meghalaya border: stone-collection areas, the Piyain river and hills.
attractions.tip: Go early. Roads are rough in rain. Bring cash for the boats.

attractions.name: Bichanakandi (Bichnakandi)
attractions.what: A clear, cool stream flowing from the hills with stone beds and boats. Some tourists go for the quiet and the view.
attractions.tip: Wear shoes with grip. Visit in the dry season.

attractions.name: Lalakhal
attractions.what: A river with blue-green water and a boat ride through jungle edges.
attractions.tip: Needs fair weather. Hire a boat with a life jacket.

attractions.name: Malnichhara Tea Estate
attractions.what: One of the oldest tea estates, a short drive from the city centre.
attractions.tip: Visit in the morning for soft light.

attractions.name: Ali Amjad's Clock
attractions.what: A colonial-era clock tower by the Surma river.
attractions.tip: Combine with a walk on the river bridge.

attractions.name: Osmani Museum
attractions.what: A museum on Bangladesh's Liberation War commander General M. A. G. Osmani.
attractions.tip: Check opening hours; closed some days.

attractions.name: Panthumai Waterfall (Kasia-Jaflong road)
attractions.what: A small waterfall and clear water, usually best in the rains.
attractions.tip: Ask drivers about the road condition.

budget.note: Simple hotels with basic AC rooms.

luxury.area: Hill and river resorts outside the city

rules: Take life jackets on every boat.
Do not buy stones or fossils collected illegally.
Carry cash: ATMs are limited at Jaflong and Ratargul.
